records.name: Lobbyist Beiläufig
records.biography_en: Has never requested a favour that was not already everyone's idea. His HyperNorm briefcase holds solutions that arrive before the public problem is announced. A dissonant card asks who paid for the question. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Vorschlag stammt selbstverständlich von allen Beteiligten.

variant_notes.note_en: Has never requested a favour that was not already everyone's idea.

records.name: Ministerin Fadenschein
records.biography_en: Calls it independence whenever the strings briefly go slack. Her HyperNorm strings connect every independent statement to an approved gesture. A dissonant card points out that she is holding the crossbar herself. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Unabhängigkeit hängt derzeit etwas lockerer.

variant_notes.note_en: Calls it independence whenever the strings briefly go slack.

records.name: Hinterzimmerboss Nebelrecht
records.biography_en: Prefers transparency that arrives thick enough to hide behind. His HyperNorm cigar offers a private atmosphere for matters declared public. A dissonant card stays visible even through the carefully cultivated haze. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Transparenz wurde ausreichend abgedunkelt.

variant_notes.note_en: Prefers transparency that arrives thick enough to hide behind.

records.name: Wahlwart Einwurf
records.biography_en: Believes participation improves noticeably when he supplies it himself. His HyperNorm ballot box overflows with consent nobody remembers expressing. A dissonant card asks whether a vote can remain a choice when he supplies both. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Beteiligung wurde vorsorglich selbst erhöht.

variant_notes.note_en: Believes participation improves noticeably when he supplies it himself.

records.name: Kurier Gegenleistung
records.biography_en: Delivers things that nobody recalls agreeing to receive. His HyperNorm envelope must arrive without having officially travelled. A dissonant card asks why the receipt is heavier than the parcel. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Zugestellt wird ausdrücklich ohne vorherigen Empfangswunsch.

variant_notes.note_en: Delivers things that nobody recalls agreeing to receive.

records.name: Hinweisgeberin Pfeifdrauf
records.biography_en: Finds her voice just after deciding it is a terrible career move. Her whistle interrupts a HyperNorm rule that mistakes silence for agreement. A dissonant card gives her something inconveniently worth protecting. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Karriere ist geklärt. Die Sache noch offen.

variant_notes.note_en: Finds her voice just after deciding it is a terrible career move.
